title: Verify Service Manager cannot delete a payment
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (this role has Invoicing and Payments = View/Create and Edit only - NO Delete).
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
A payment has been recorded against the invoice.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab and locate the recorded payment.
2. Look for a Delete option on the payment; if present, click it.
expected: Deleting the payment is BLOCKED: the Delete action is hidden or disabled, or clicking it returns a permission error. Record in the test run whether the control is hidden, greyed out, or errors.
